about: The web push payload each subscribed device is sent, before encryption (refactor plan step S10). The override run sets OPENV_PUSH_NOTIFICATION_TYPES to exactly the types the default allow-list leaves out.

deliveries.scenario: org.member_added: an admin adds a member

sends.payload: {"title":"Someone joined the workspace","body":"Ben Okafor joined this workspace as a member.","url":"/projects","tag":"membership_changed:org-acme"}

deliveries.scenario: org.invitation_sent: an admin invites an address as an admin

sends.payload: {"title":"An invitation was sent","body":"frank@example.test was invited to this workspace as an admin.","url":"/projects","tag":"membership_changed:org-acme"}
